Use the standard OpenFOAM interFoam damBreak tutorial as the base case.
Set application to interFoam in system/controlDict.
Use a 2D mesh extruded one cell in the z direction.
Set the front and back patches to type empty.
Use a rectangular domain of 0.584 m by 0.584 m in the x-y plane with a one-cell thickness in z.
Initialize the water column using setFields with alpha.water equal to 1 inside the column and 0 outside.
Set the water column dimensions to 0.292 m in the x direction and 0.584 m in the y direction.
Keep all other solver settings, physical properties, and boundary conditions from the standard interFoam damBreak tutorial.
